descriptionHtml:
KNOWN BUG-UI-1. lab.js add(): if (existing && id !== "p07") existing.quantity++; else cart.push(...) — every click on p07 pushes a new line. Spec: «Одна позиція на product_id».

The test asserts the behaviour required by spec.txt; it stays red until the server is fixed.
